fail_points.text: Still INFERRED: TD pages give only the beneficiary fields ('beneficiary's name, bank, account number, and account type'), saved as a template. They do not list the amount, funding-account or memo/purpose fields, and no TD app wire demo or video was found. The business agreement adds that TD 'will not process Funds Transfers with incomplete required information fields.'

exceptions.trigger: Business asks TD to cancel or amend a submitted wire
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer contacts TD; cancellation or amendment requests go through the same security procedure as the original order (account verification and callback to a phone number on file).
exceptions.bank_handling: 'The Security Procedure will also apply to any amendment or cancellation of a Funds Transfer.' Refunds: 'a refund will be made only after we have received confirmation of the effective cancellation of the Funds Transfer order' (business accounts; agreement undated).
exceptions.resolution: Refund only once the beneficiary bank/network confirms cancellation; unauthorized transfers or errors must be reported within the agreement's deadline.

exceptions.trigger: TD declines or holds a wire (incomplete fields, discretion, OFAC)
exceptions.customer_experience: Wire is not processed or is delayed; TD may tell the customer by phone, email or in writing.
exceptions.bank_handling: 'We may, in our sole discretion, decline to process any Funds Transfer without cause and without prior notice.' 'We will not process Funds Transfers with incomplete required information fields.' TD 'may temporarily suspend processing of a transaction for greater scrutiny or verification against the OFAC list'; notice 'by any means, including orally, by email or in writing.' (business accounts; agreement undated).
exceptions.resolution: Customer corrects and resubmits, or waits for the OFAC review.

assessment: Notable 2025–2026 upgrade: SMB wires moved into the consumer-grade app with saved recipients; international wires still not in app.
